name: SRE Holdings Corp
summary: SRE Holdings Corporation operates within Japan, concentrating on artificial intelligence cloud services, consulting, and real estate technology. The company develops and supplies integrated cloud solutions, featuring algorithms and tools powered by machine learning and other advanced methodologies, specifically tailored to enhance efficiency in the real estate industry. Additionally, its operations extend to conventional real estate services, including property brokerage and the development and sale of residential condominiums. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was formerly known as Sony Real Estate Corporation before rebranding as SRE Holdings Corporation in June 2019.
